key_insight: A transformer-enhanced transfer learning model can screen greener solvent substitutes with reliable uncertainty-aware predictions even when experimental solubility data are scarce.
engineering_relevance: The tool helps organic photovoltaics and other emerging materials workflows replace hazardous solvents faster by ranking candidate green alternatives for high-throughput selection.
method: Pretrain on QM9 molecular targets, then transfer to solubility-related descriptors with minimal task-specific data.
Add uncertainty quantification so users can assess confidence before experimental validation.
Deploy as a customizable screening pipeline for ranking solvent substitutes in lab workflows.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong performance on well-studied targets like Hansen solubility parameters and dielectric constant, and also on sparse targets such as Gutmann donor and acceptor numbers.
watch_item: Predictions still depend on limited and uneven training data, so low-data targets and out-of-distribution solvents should be experimentally verified before adoption.
paper_title: A green solvent screening tool for emerging materials via uncertainty aware, transformer enhanced transfer learning
